description: Team Riley default for Astro sites deployed on Netlify. Patch and minor updates auto-merge once the Netlify deploy preview is green; majors and the shared Shopify engine wait for a human.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Patch and minor updates auto-merge, but only after every status check (the Netlify deploy preview) passes. A repo with no checks keeps the PR open for a human.
Astro and its integrations move together.
Tailwind and its plugins move together.
Alpine and its plugins move together.
Test tooling moves together and is safe to auto-merge on green.
Major versions change config (Tailwind 3 to 4, Astro majors): a labelled PR for a person to read, never auto-merged.
The shared Shopify engine is pinned to a git tag on purpose. A new tag opens a PR to review (run the site's unit + e2e tests), never auto-merged.
@lucide/astro stays below 1.0: 1.x removed the brand icons (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) the site footers use.
